We need to correctly call tool. Let's search for sulfonamide formation template.


<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (S(=O)(=O)N) bond, which will be useful for disconnecting the target molecule into a sulfonyl chloride and an aniline.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
